purpose: Evaluate whether verified contracted shift types can reduce the number of shifts needed for JPY 200,000 gross without adding a user operation or assuming unsafe availability.

historical_availability_evidence.interpretation: Employer demand for nights is plausible, but the user's safe night availability and actual assignment acceptance are not verified. Historical selections do not support silently changing the active plan.

decision.conditional_shortening_path: 17 total shifts made of 12 day and 5 night shifts could reach JPY 200,900 and may complete one shift earlier.
decision.activation_gate: Activate only after non-sensitive evidence that night work is physically safe for the user and the employer accepts night assignments.
decision.reason: Do not optimize calendar time by inventing physical availability or overriding a six-month day-only selection history.

success_condition: A safe accepted mix creates a binding gross wage claim of at least JPY 200,000 in one pay period.
withdrawal_condition: Withdraw any night mix if the user reports it is unsafe, no night assignment is accepted, or rest windows would be inadequate.
privacy: No employer name, person name, address, email, phone, account identifier, message ID, attachment URL, or secret is stored.
